purpose: Determine whether information FLOWED, remained TRACEABLE, and produced CROSS-IMAGE RELATIONS. Nothing here scores aesthetic quality or philosophical depth; those live in each case's manual_review_questions and are deliberately not automated.

sculpture.note: Resolved through `inquiry_session.corpus.resolve`, which reads and never writes. These three fingerprints are byte-identical to the ones carried by the rev6 baseline export, so that export and any run made today read the same pixels.

architecture.note: NOT CANONICAL AND NOT USABLE. `scripts/inquiry_intelligence_rehearsal.py --propose-architecture` searches the database read-only and writes a contact sheet to `architecture-control/`. Ids become canonical only when a person has looked at the images and said so — a control set assembled from metadata alone would make every cross-domain result a claim about the search query.

what_this_cannot_decide: whether an answer is beautiful, deep, or worth reading
whether a relation it found is INTERESTING rather than merely present
whether a proposal combines two regimes or averages them
whether the vocabulary it discovered is the vocabulary these works deserve
